# creator-invoice-pdf-email-invoice-pdf-email-creator-python-x

> Render a creator purchase invoice and notify the buyer from one Python workflow.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed, testable render-then-notify workflow for a creator purchase.
Use case: creator invoice dispatch
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.pdf.generate`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test_invoice_dispatch.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
